description: Database migration (004_inventory_workflows.sql) + TypeScript types for new tables (StockTransfer, StockTransferItem, GoodsReceivedNote, GRNItem, StockAdjustmentReason) + Service layer (src/services/inventory/) with movements, transfers, receiving, adjustments, and alerts logic
steps: Create supabase/migrations/004_inventory_workflows.sql with: stock_transfers table (id, transfer_number, source_warehouse_id, destination_warehouse_id, status CHECK constraint, requested_by, approved_by, rejected_by, rejection_reason, notes, timestamps, completed_at, CONSTRAINT chk_different_warehouses), stock_transfer_items table (id, transfer_id FK, product_id FK, requested_quantity CHECK>0, transferred_quantity, notes), goods_received_notes table (id, grn_number UNIQUE, purchase_order_id FK, warehouse_id FK, received_by FK, supplier_invoice_number, notes, received_at, created_at), grn_items table (id, grn_id FK CASCADE, purchase_order_item_id FK, product_id FK, quantity_received CHECK>0, quantity_rejected DEFAULT 0, rejection_reason, batch_number, expiry_date), stock_adjustment_reasons table (id, code UNIQUE, name, description, requires_approval, is_active). Include seed data for adjustment reasons, sequences for transfer/GRN numbers, generate_transfer_number() and generate_grn_number() functions, RLS policies for all new tables, updated_at trigger for stock_transfers, and indexes. Use exact SQL from the user specification.

Update src/types/database.ts: Add TransferStatus type ('pending'|'approved'|'in_transit'|'completed'|'rejected'), AdjustmentReason type ('damaged'|'expired'|'theft'|'count_correction'|'quality_reject'|'sample'|'other'), and interfaces: StockTransfer, StockTransferItem, GoodsReceivedNote, GRNItem, StockAdjustmentReason. Ensure fields match the 004 migration exactly.

Create src/services/inventory/types.ts with workflow-specific types: CreateMovementInput, TransferRequest, TransferApproval, ReceiveItemsInput, CreateAdjustmentInput, LowStockAlert, MovementHistoryFilters, TransferFilters, AdjustmentFilters, GRNInput

Create src/services/inventory/movements.ts: createMovement() - validates stock availability for out/transfer types by querying inventory table, inserts into stock_movements (trigger handles qty update), throws if insufficient stock. getMovementHistory() - paginated with product/warehouse/type/date filters. getProductTraceability() - full chain for single product.

Create src/services/inventory/transfers.ts: initiateTransfer() - generates transfer number, creates stock_transfers + stock_transfer_items records with status 'pending'. approveTransfer() - validates stock in source warehouse, updates status to 'approved', records approved_by. rejectTransfer() - updates status to 'rejected' with reason. completeTransfer() - creates paired stock_movements (type 'transfer' out from source + type 'in' to destination for each item), updates transferred_quantity on items, sets status 'completed' + completed_at. getTransferHistory() - with joins for warehouse names.

Create src/services/inventory/receiving.ts: receiveItems() - validates PO status is 'confirmed' or 'partially_received', creates GRN with generate_grn_number(), for each item creates grn_items record + stock_movement (type 'in'), updates purchase_order_items.received_quantity, determines if PO is fully or partially received and updates PO status accordingly. getReceivingHistory() - GRNs for a PO. createGoodsReceivedNote() - assembles GRN data structure.

Create src/services/inventory/adjustments.ts: createAdjustment() - validates reason is valid, for negative adjustments validates sufficient stock, creates stock_movement with type 'adjustment' (positive or negative qty per the trigger logic). getAdjustmentHistory() - filterable by reason/warehouse/product/date.

Create src/services/inventory/alerts.ts: checkLowStock() - queries inventory joined with products where quantity < reorder_point. generateAlerts() - creates notification records for low-stock products. dismissAlert() - marks notification as read. getLowStockProducts() - returns products below min_stock_level with current vs required quantities.
Create src/services/inventory/index.ts barrel export file exporting all functions from movements, transfers, receiving, adjustments, alerts modules.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/004_inventory_workflows.sql contains all tables, constraints, sequences, functions, RLS policies, triggers, and indexes specified
src/types/database.ts has all new type definitions matching the migration schema
All service files exist with proper TypeScript types and Supabase client calls
bun run type-check passes with zero errors
